description.en: Plugins for DeepSeek Harness by kaijia323: MCP server panel.
description.zh: kaijia323 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：MCP 面板。

description.en: Adds an MCP entry under Plugins: see every MCP server with its connection state, endpoint and tools, and add, edit or delete servers in place.
description.zh: 在「插件」下面新增 MCP 入口：查看 MCP 服务器的连接状态、入口与工具清单，并可直接新增 / 编辑 / 删除服务器。
